# General Legal <> Ryan
Date: 2026-10-29 | Duration: 38m

## Summary
GrowthBook reported strong satisfaction with General Legal’s responsive support and balance between risk management and deal execution across customer agreements, privacy documents, and sales compensation letters. Slack remains the preferred workflow, including flexible private channels for sensitive matters, while portal adoption would require clearer benefits. Key operational opportunities include sending finalized order forms directly to HubSpot and tracking customer-specific negotiated documents. Chris Kleiner’s negotiation playbook is improving consistency, but GrowthBook still needs deal-size thresholds for when negotiations should occur. GrowthBook also requested recurring negotiation-learning summaries, Slack-based legal access, and MCP testing for AI-assisted analysis. Monthly reporting could summarize deals supported, closures, time spent, deal size, sales-efficiency trends, account-executive patterns, and inputs relevant to customer acquisition economics. Ryan McGurk offered product feedback and potential referrals through Stage Two.

## Keywords
Slack legal support, HubSpot integration, Contract negotiation tracking, Legal negotiation playbook, AI and MCP workflows, Legal matter dashboards

## Action Items
**Ryan McGurk**
Finalise GrowthBook legal negotiation thresholds (13:03)
Promote General Legal within Stage Two network (27:04)
Aggregate Stage Two participant contacts (27:45)

**Javed Qadruddin**
Send Ryan MCP setup information (21:52)
